For return_on_assets_percent, required components in formula order are: target full-year net income, previous-year-end total assets, target-year-end total assets. Normalize each value to currency units before calculating. All components must share one currency. If any required component is absent or currencies differ, submit status missing_components with an empty components array and an empty ratio_value. If the average of previous-year-end and target-year-end total assets is nonpositive, submit status undefined_denominator with all components and an empty ratio_value. Negative net income is valid. Round only the final ratio to two decimals using ROUND_HALF_UP; do not round component values.
